[Advance Base Defender]
This place is too dangerous. Return to the base, now!
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守衛]
這裡太危險了。馬上返回基地！

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
I'll see that no monster sneak into the base.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守衛]
我會確保沒有魔物潛入基地。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
Sigh, how long do I have to do this?
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守衛]
唉，我還要在這裡守多久？

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
Don't worry. I'm here to protect you.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守衛]
別擔心，我會保護你的。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
We're in the middle of the battlefield. I can't talk for too long.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守衛]
我們正在戰場上，不能聊太久。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
Please step aside. You're blocking my vision.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守衛]
請讓開，你擋住我的視線了。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
If you have time for chit-chat, then kill one more enemy instead.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守衛]
有時間閒聊，不如再去消滅一隻敵人。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
Bah, I'm cold and hungry... Oh, I was just talking to myself.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守衛]
唉，又冷又餓...啊，我剛才是在自言自語。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
Be careful: this place is overrun with dangerous monsters.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守衛]
小心，這裡到處都是危險的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
For every monster I kill, one or more appear to take its place.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守衛]
我每消滅一隻魔物，就會有一隻或更多新的魔物出現。

scripts.text: [Advance Base Defender]
scripts.translation: [前哨基地守衛]

scripts.text: - Cannot progress with the dialogue because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續對話。 -

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
You look super weak!
Why are you here??
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
你看起來也太弱了！
為什麼來這裡？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Well, there are not enough people!
But we will wait until you reach level 150.
Please come back later!
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
唉，人手不夠！
不過我們會等你升到150級。
請之後再來！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Have you noticed it, too?
Yes, the monsters in this area are really quite strange.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
你也注意到了嗎？
沒錯，這裡的魔物確實很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
They appear to be mutant versions of Midgard monsters
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
它們看起來像是米德加爾特魔物的變種。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Worse still, their number has been rapidly increasing.
We must keep an eye on them.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
更糟的是，它們的數量正在迅速增加。
我們必須密切關注。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
To my regret, everyone seems so busy that I can't ask them for help, despite the seriousness of the investigation.
This is not a safe environment.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
遺憾的是大家似乎都很忙，儘管調查非常緊急，我還是找不到人幫忙。
這裡並不安全。

scripts.text: What's going on?
scripts.translation: 發生什麼事了？

scripts.text: Why can't you do it yourself?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼不自己去做？

scripts.text: Do you want me to do it?
scripts.translation: 要我去做嗎？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
The environmental characteristics of this area are making the investigation too difficult.
The scenery looks familiar, yet in a way... strange.
The place looks like it's on the verge of utter collapse but.. I can see bursts of vibrant growth.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
這裡的環境讓調查變得非常困難。
景色看起來很熟悉，卻又透著幾分...詭異。
這裡彷彿隨時會徹底崩塌，但...我又看到了蓬勃生長的景象。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
What is this place?
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
這到底是什麼地方？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Like everyone else from a noble background,
I only know how to command others.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
和其他出身貴族的人一樣，
我只會命令別人。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Of all those monsters,
^0000FFFire Condors^000000 look most dangerous.
Those birds with burning tails charge headlong toward everyone they see. You may be able to run from them, but you will always get singed.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
所有魔物當中，
^0000FF火焰禿鷹^000000最危險。
那些尾巴燃燒的鳥會朝看到的所有人猛衝。你或許能逃開，但總會被燎到。

scripts.text: Do you want me to hunt Fire Condors?
scripts.translation: 要我去獵殺火焰禿鷹嗎？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
No, I have no one to dispose their carcasses.
My purpose is, after all, an investigation.
Just bring me
15 ^FF0000Burning Feathers^000000
from ^0000FFFire Condors^000000.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
不，我沒人手處理它們的屍體。
畢竟我來這裡是為了調查。
你只要從^0000FF火焰禿鷹^000000身上收集
15根^FF0000燃燒羽毛^000000帶給我就行。

scripts.text: I'm as busy as you!
scripts.translation: 我也和你一樣忙！

scripts.text: Got it.
scripts.translation: 知道了。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
You acted as if you'd help me.
Were you messing with me?
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
你剛才表現得像是要幫我。
是在耍我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Bring me
^FF000015 Burning Feathers^000000
from ^0000FFFire Condors^000000.
Hurry before more people fall victim to those vicious birds!
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
從^0000FF火焰禿鷹^000000身上收集
^FF000015根燃燒羽毛^000000帶給我。
快點，別讓更多人遭那些兇鳥毒手！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
I thought you'd be hard at work by now,
gathering ^FF000015 Burning Feathers^000000
from ^0000FFFire Condors^000000,
so I called an emergency meeting of
my investigators.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
我以為你現在應該已經在努力收集
^0000FF火焰禿鷹^000000身上的^FF000015根燃燒羽毛^000000，
所以召集調查員們開了緊急會議。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
And you're still in town,
enjoying a leisurely walk.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
而你還在城裡
悠閒地散步。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
You brought
all the ^FF000015 Burning Feathers^000000.
Thank you. Now I can
proceed with my investigation.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
你把
全部^FF000015根燃燒羽毛^000000都帶來了。
謝謝，現在我可以
繼續調查了。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Most of all, I can finally enjoy the warmth of a fire!
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
最重要的是，我終於能享受火焰的溫暖了！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Did you notice the worrisome expression on my face?
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
你注意到我臉上憂心忡忡的表情了嗎？

scripts.text: Nope. Never.
scripts.translation: 才沒有，完全沒注意到。

scripts.text: I did, instantly.
scripts.translation: 我立刻就注意到了。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
That's not the answer I expected,
but I'll continue with the spiel
I've prepared.
Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
這不是我預想的回答，
不過我還是繼續念準備好的臺詞吧。
唉...

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
A scout hasn't returned
from the Flaming Basin.
I want you to go check
what happened to him.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
一名偵察兵去了烈焰盆地後一直沒回來。
我想讓你去看看他出了什麼事。

scripts.text: No can do.
scripts.translation: 我辦不到。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 好。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
I know you'll do it anyway!
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
我就知道你還是會去的！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
The scout headed for the area teeming with monsters.
Keep your eyes peeled for him.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
那名偵察兵去了魔物成群的區域。
留意一下他的下落。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Not bad! You guys....
Please eat three bowls of gongs!
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
幹得不錯！你們...
來吃三碗米飯吧！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
A scout hasn't returned
from the Flaming Basin.
I want you to go check
what happened to him.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
一名偵察兵去了烈焰盆地後一直沒回來。
我想讓你去看看他出了什麼事。

scripts.text: No can do.
scripts.translation: 我辦不到。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 好。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
I know you'll do it anyway!
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
我就知道你還是會去的！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
The scout headed for the area teeming with monsters.
Keep your eyes peeled for him.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
那名偵察兵去了魔物成群的區域。
留意一下他的下落。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
I sent you out to look for the scout.
Did you come back or haven't you left at all?
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
我派你去找偵察兵了。
你是回來覆命了，還是根本沒出發？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Go look for the scout in the place teeming with monsters!
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
去魔物成群的地方找偵察兵！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Did you find the scout?
He's resting and rewriting his scout journal?
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
找到偵察兵了嗎？
他正在休息並重寫偵察日誌？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
He does not disappoint me.
He's a good soldier!
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
他果然沒讓我失望。
真是個好士兵！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Now that we've found the missing scout,
I want you to move on to the next mission.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
既然找到了失蹤的偵察兵，
接下來該執行下一個任務了。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
You know the number of mysterious monsters
in this Flaming Basin has been continuously increasing.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
你也知道，這片烈焰盆地裡
神秘魔物的數量一直在增加。

scripts.text: I know.
scripts.translation: 我知道。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Things could quickly go out of control
if they expand to the outside world.
If they encounter other monsters in Midgard or the Other World,
they could go on a rampage,
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
如果它們擴散到外界，
局勢很快就會失控。
如果它們在米德加爾特或異世界遇到其他魔物，
可能會大肆作亂，

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
could spread deadly virus,
could procreate powerful mutants,
or worse.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
還可能傳播致命病毒、
繁殖出強大的變異體，
甚至造成更糟的後果。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
For now, the best solution would be
a large cull, and I want you to do it.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
目前最好的辦法是
大規模清剿，我想請你們去做。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Please exterminate
20 ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000
and ^0000FFFire Frilldoras^000000.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
請消滅
20只^0000FF火焰沙人^000000
和^0000FF火焰傘蜥^000000。

scripts.text: Do it yourself!
scripts.translation: 你自己去！

scripts.text: I'll do my best.
scripts.translation: 我會盡力。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
I hate to repeat myself,
but like everyone else from a noble background,
I only know how to command others.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
我不想重複，
但和其他出身貴族的人一樣，
我只會命令別人。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Hurry, those monsters are breeding even as we speak.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
快點，那些魔物還在不斷繁殖。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Please exterminate
20 ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000
and 20 ^0000FFFire Frilldoras^000000.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
請消滅
20只^0000FF火焰沙人^000000
和20只^0000FF火焰傘蜥^000000。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
You exterminated
20 ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000
and 20 ^0000FFFire Frilldoras^000000 as I ordered.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
你照我的吩咐消滅了
20只^0000FF火焰沙人^000000
和20只^0000FF火焰傘蜥^000000。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Thanks to you we've found an effective wayto deal with the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
多虧了你們，我們找到了對付這些魔物的有效方法。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
From this moment on, my soldiers will take over.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
從現在起，我計程車兵會接手。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Hurry, those monsters are
multiplying themselves even as we speak.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
快點，那些魔物還在不斷繁殖。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Please exterminate
20 ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000
and 20 ^0000FFFire Frilldoras^000000.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
請消滅
20只^0000FF火焰沙人^000000
和20只^0000FF火焰傘蜥^000000。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
So leave it to us to take care of this area, and you go ahead and head north.
I want you to do something about that strange group of people over there.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
這片區域交給我們處理，你繼續往北走。
去處理一下那邊那群奇怪的人。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
They've appeared out of nowhere.
doing everything they can to pester us.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
他們突然冒了出來，
想方設法騷擾我們。

scripts.text: - Cannot progress with the dialogue because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續對話。 -

scripts.text:
[Scout]
I was sent to investigate these monsters.
It's unfair that I'm alone
in this dangerous place with no backup!
scripts.translation:
[偵察兵]
我是來調查這些魔物的。
這麼危險的地方居然沒有支援，讓我一個人待著，太不公平了！

scripts.text:
[Scout]
I was sent to investigate these monsters.
It's unfair that I'm alone
in this dangerous place with no backup!
scripts.translation:
[偵察兵]
我是來調查這些魔物的。
這麼危險的地方居然沒有支援，讓我一個人待著，太不公平了！

scripts.text:
[Scout]
Argh, I'm just gonna go AWOL!
scripts.translation:
[偵察兵]
啊，我乾脆擅離職守算了！

scripts.text:
[Scout]
Welcome!
I'm in dire need of help!
scripts.translation:
[偵察兵]
來得正好！
我急需幫助！

scripts.text:
[Scout]
I came here alone on a recon mission.
A horde of monsters surrounded me, keeping me from leaving,
so I had no choice but to hang around.
scripts.translation:
[偵察兵]
我獨自來執行偵察任務。
一大群魔物包圍了我，害我沒法離開，
只能一直躲在這裡。

scripts.text: Stay chilling then.
scripts.translation: 那你就繼續待著唄。

scripts.text: Let's go back with me.
scripts.translation: 跟我一起回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
You're afraid I might ask for help,
I see.
scripts.translation:
[偵察兵]
看來你是怕我開口求助啊。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
I'm not injured, save a few scrapes,
but ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000 stole
my ^FF0000scout journal^000000.
scripts.translation:
[偵察兵]
除了幾處擦傷，我沒受什麼傷，
但^0000FF火焰沙人^000000搶走了
我的^FF0000偵察日誌^000000。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
Without the ^FF0000scout journal^000000, I can't go back.
I'll be lucky
if my superiors don't court-martial me.
scripts.translation:
[偵察兵]
沒有^FF0000偵察日誌^000000，我就沒法回去。
要是上級不把我送上軍事法庭，我就謝天謝地了。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
Don't I sound pitiful?
Doesn't it inspire you to help me?
scripts.translation:
[偵察兵]
我是不是很可憐？
這樣還不能讓你想幫幫我嗎？

scripts.text: Neh.
scripts.translation: 才不呢。

scripts.text: It does.
scripts.translation: 是有點。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
All right, then I'll just have to
stay here and chill until help arrives.
scripts.translation:
[偵察兵]
好吧，那我就繼續在這裡歇著，
等救援來吧。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
Okay, here's what you can do to help:
Please bring ^FF0000Scout Journals^000000
from ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000.
scripts.translation:
[偵察兵]
好吧，你可以這樣幫我：
去^0000FF火焰沙人^000000那裡
帶回^FF0000偵察日誌^000000。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
The journal could have been separated into pages, snapped at by those feral monsters.
I don't care; I still need them to show to my superiors.
Please bring me
20 ^FF0000Scout Journals^000000.
scripts.translation:
[偵察兵]
那些野蠻魔物可能把日誌撕成了碎頁，還咬壞了。
我不在乎，還是得拿它們給上級看。
請給我
20份^FF0000偵察日誌^000000。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
Be careful--they can ambush you and snatch away ^FF0000Scout Journals^000000 before you know it.
scripts.translation:
[偵察兵]
小心，它們可能會伏擊你，
趁你不注意搶走^FF0000偵察日誌^000000。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
Please bring 20 ^FF0000Scout Journals^000000
from ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000.
scripts.translation:
[偵察兵]
請從^0000FF火焰沙人^000000那裡
帶回20份^FF0000偵察日誌^000000。

scripts.text:

Be careful--they can ambush you and snatch away ^FF0000Scout Journals^000000 before you know it.
scripts.translation:

小心，它們可能會伏擊你，

scripts.text:
[Scout]
Did you already find
20 ^FF0000Scout Journals^000000?
If I knew you're so fast, I would have asked you for 100 pages instead.
scripts.translation:
[偵察兵]
你已經找到
20份^FF0000偵察日誌^000000了嗎？
早知道你這麼快，我就該讓你找100頁了。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
My wounds are throbbing from the thought of punishment
that might await me at the base.
scripts.translation:
[偵察兵]
一想到基地裡可能等著我的懲罰，
我的傷口就開始隱隱作痛。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
I'll follow you as soon as I'm done reorganizing these pages.
Please report to the Investigator
and put in a good word
for me.
scripts.translation:
[偵察兵]
等我把這些紙頁整理好就跟你走。
請去找調查員，
替我說幾句好話。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
I'll follow you as soon as I'm done reorganizing these pages.

and put in a good word
for me.
scripts.translation:
[偵察兵]
等我把這些紙頁整理好就跟你走。
請去找調查員，
替我說幾句好話。

scripts.text:
[Scout]
I was sent to investigate these monsters.
It's unfair that I'm alone
in this dangerous place with no backup!
scripts.translation:
[偵察兵]
我是來調查這些魔物的。
這麼危險的地方居然沒有支援，讓我一個人待著，太不公平了！

scripts.text: You have been ambushed by Fire Sandmen!
scripts.translation: 你被火焰沙人伏擊了！

scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續對話。 -

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
Finally, doomsday has come!
Destruction is a blessing!
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
末日終於降臨了！
毀滅即是祝福！

scripts.text:

Guide us to the inside!

scripts.translation:

帶我們進去！
我們是神選之人！
世界毀滅的時刻就要開始了。

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
Blood for the blood go~~
I mean destruction is good!
Destruction is a blessing!
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
血債血償~~
不對，我是說毀滅真好！
毀滅即是祝福！

Destruction is a blessing!
scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

毀滅！即是！祝福！

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers]
Destruction! Blessing!
We are the chosen ones!
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團]
毀滅！祝福！
我們是神選之人！

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
Guide us to the inside!
We're chosen by the gods!
The day when the destruction of the world begins,
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
帶我們進去！
我們是神選之人！
世界毀滅的時刻就要開始了，

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
The gun is good!
The HODE is evil!
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
槍是好東西！
霍德是邪惡的！

scripts.text: What god do you serve?
scripts.translation: 你們侍奉哪位神？

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你們是誰？

scripts.text: Go back!
scripts.translation: 回去！

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
We serve the God of Destruction!
He oversees the destruction of everything--from the destruction of a star to that of an entire galaxy,
and from the spoilage of my breakfast to that of my dinner.
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
我們侍奉毀滅之神！
他掌管萬物的毀滅——從恆星到整個星系的消亡，
也掌管我早餐和晚餐的腐壞。

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
We're the Doom Prayers!
We serve the God of Destruction,
and pray to him to bless us with the end of the world.
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
我們是末日祈禱團！
我們侍奉毀滅之神，
祈禱他賜予我們世界末日的祝福。

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
Only after everything else is destroyed,
we can be truly blessed.
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
只有萬物都被毀滅之後，
我們才能得到真正的祝福。

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
Those sudden cracks
in the ground.
Those talking Cats.
Those green giants.
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
地上突然出現的裂縫。
那些會說話的貓。
那些綠色巨人。

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
They prove the end is near!
Oh, doomsday has arrived!
Destruction is a blessing!
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
這些都證明末日將近！
哦，末日已經降臨！
毀滅即是祝福！

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
No, we won't!
Finally, doomsday has arrived!
We've been dying for the blessing!
I want to be there before everyone else!
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
不，我們不走！
末日終於來了！
我們盼著這份祝福已經很久了！
我要趕在所有人之前進去！

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
Hell no, we won't go!
Let us in there!
We've been chosen by the God of Destruction.
Unlike you, we're invincible!
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
絕不走！
讓我們進去！
我們是毀滅之神選中的人。
我們可不像你們那麼脆弱！

scripts.text: Can you prove it?
scripts.translation: 你能證明嗎？

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
How dare you challenge me?!
All right, I'll prove it to you!
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
你竟敢質疑我？！
好，我就證明給你看！

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
Search this Doomsland and find ^FF000040 Blessing Stones^000000.
Throw them at us, and you'll see.
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
去末日之地找^FF000040塊祝福之石^000000。
把它們扔向我們，你就知道了。

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
The moment they hit our bodies,
they'll turn into flower petals with a loud pop!
Destruction is a blessing!
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
它們一砸中我們，
就會砰的一聲變成花瓣！
毀滅即是祝福！

scripts.text: Doomsland?
scripts.translation: 末日之地？

scripts.text:
[Guard]
That's what those crazy people call this Flaming Basin.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
那是那群瘋子對這片火焰盆地的稱呼。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
And what they call ^FF0000Blessing Stones^000000 are simply the debris fell off ^0000FFFire Golems^000000.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
他們所謂的^FF0000祝福之石^000000，其實只是^0000FF火焰巨石怪^000000掉下來的碎片。

scripts.text:
The only way to send away these crazy people must be prove them they're wrong.
Do you want to hunt ^0000FFFire Golems^000000
and collect 40 ^FF0000Blessing Stones^000000?
scripts.translation:
趕走這群瘋子的唯一辦法，就是證明他們錯了。
要去獵殺^0000FF火焰巨石怪^000000
並收集40塊^FF0000祝福之石^000000嗎？

scripts.text: No, I couldn't care less!
scripts.translation: 不，我才沒興趣！

scripts.text: I'll collect the stones.
scripts.translation: 我去收集石頭。

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
I see you're afraid of witnessing the grace of our god lest that might change your mind.
Stop bothering me and scram!
Destruction is a blessing!
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
看來你是害怕見證神蹟，怕自己會因此改變主意。
別來煩我，快滾！
毀滅即是祝福！

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
Go ahead, bring ^FF0000Blessing Stones^000000 and throw them at us!
You'll see those stones turning into falling flower petals!
Then you'll cry and beg me to let you join us.
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
去吧，帶著^FF0000祝福之石^000000來砸我們！
你會看到那些石頭變成飄落的花瓣！
然後你會哭著求我讓你加入。

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
Search this Doomsland and find ^FF000040 Blessing Stones^000000.
Throw them at us, and you'll see.
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
去末日之地找^FF000040塊祝福之石^000000。
把它們扔向我們，你就知道了。

它們一砸中我們，
就會砰的一聲變成花瓣！
毀滅即是祝福！

Okay, we're ready.
Throw the stones at us!
scripts.translation:

你帶來了40塊^FF0000祝福之石^000000。
好了，我們準備好了。
把石頭扔向我們吧！

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
Be prepared for the miracle!
Come on, hit us hard!
Destruction is a blessing!
scripts.translation:

準備好見證奇蹟吧！
來吧，用力砸我們！
毀滅即是祝福！

石頭並沒有變成花瓣，反而把被砸中的人打得很痛。
你決定停止投擲石頭。

My head!

scripts.translation:

哎喲！
我的頭！

My nose!

scripts.translation:

我的鼻子！

scripts.text:

Hurt!
Hurt like hell!
I wasn't ready!
Stop! Let's do over!
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
好痛！
痛死我了！
我還沒準備好！
住手！重來！

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
Brothers and sisters, calm down!
That heretic has fooled us with the wrong stones!
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
兄弟姐妹們，冷靜！
那個異端用錯了石頭騙我們！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

Destruction is a blessing!
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團]
毀滅即是祝福！
毀滅即是祝福！

[Doom Prayers Leader]
You're a coward!
I command you again.
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
你真是個膽小鬼！
我再命令你一次。

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
Bring the blood of the monsters that roam Doomsland.
I shall drink it and levitate to guide you all to the true faith!
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
把末日之地遊蕩的魔物之血帶來。
我要喝下它，藉此升空，引領你們走向真正的信仰！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
He means the ^FF0000Monster Bloods^000000
from ^0000FFFire Frilldoras^000000 and and ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000.
I presume 30 bottles should suffice.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
他說的是^FF0000怪獸血液^000000，
來自^0000FF火焰傘蜥^000000和^0000FF火焰沙人^000000。
我想30瓶應該夠了。

scripts.text: No, I couldn't care less!
scripts.translation: 不，我才沒興趣！

scripts.text: I'll collect Monster Bloods.
scripts.translation: 我去收集怪獸血液。

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
I knew you'd say yes!
I can sense your fear about the possibility of witnessing the grace of the God of Destruction.
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
我就知道你會答應！
我能感覺到你害怕見證毀滅之神的恩典。

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
Stop bothering me and scram!
Destruction is a blessing!
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
別來煩我，快滾！
毀滅即是祝福！

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
Now go bring me Monster Bloods!
Hunt those heinous ^0000FFFire Frilldoras^000000 and and ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000, and bring me 30 ^FF0000Monster Bloods^000000.
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
現在去給我找怪獸血液！
獵殺那些邪惡的^0000FF火焰傘蜥^000000和^0000FF火焰沙人^000000，給我帶來30瓶^FF0000怪獸血液^000000。

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
This is a perilous task.
I'll understand if you want to run.
If you really want to do this against my advice, then do as you wish.
Mwah hah hah!
scripts.translation:

這任務很危險。

如果不聽勸，非要去做，那就隨你吧。
哇哈哈！

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

你這個異端還真是閒得慌，竟然把全部^FF0000怪獸血液^000000都帶來了。
